name: 008-proforma-workflow
statements: DROP TRIGGER invoice_drafts_no_issued_update
DROP TRIGGER invoice_drafts_no_issued_delete
DROP TRIGGER invoice_drafts_series_insert
DROP TRIGGER invoice_drafts_series_update
DROP TRIGGER issued_invoices_no_update
DROP TRIGGER issued_invoices_no_delete

CREATE TABLE invoice_drafts_new(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,customer_id TEXT,customer_party_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(customer_party_type IN('company','individual')),customer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,customer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,customer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,customer_city TEXT NOT NULL,customer_street TEXT NOT NULL,customer_county TEXT,customer_postal_code TEXT,series TEXT NOT NULL,issue_date TEXT NOT NULL,due_date TEXT,currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='RON'),status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN('draft','issued','proforma_issued')),UNIQUE(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,customer_id)REFERENCES customers(organization_id,id))STRICT
INSERT INTO invoice_drafts_new SELECT * FROM invoice_drafts
DROP TABLE invoice_drafts
ALTER TABLE invoice_drafts_new RENAME TO invoice_drafts

CREATE TABLE issued_invoices_new(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,draft_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,fiscal_year INTEGER NOT NULL,document_type TEXT NOT NULL,series TEXT NOT NULL,number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(number>0),issue_date TEXT NOT NULL,due_date TEXT,issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_city TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_street TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_county TEXT,issuer_postal_code TEXT,customer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,customer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,customer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,customer_city TEXT NOT NULL,customer_street TEXT NOT NULL,customer_county TEXT,customer_postal_code TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_total TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,e_factura_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_sent' CHECK(e_factura_status IN('not_sent','pending','sent','accepted','rejected')),customer_party_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(customer_party_type IN('company','individual')),UNIQUE(organization_id,fiscal_year,document_type,series,number),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,draft_id)REFERENCES invoice_drafts(organization_id,id))STRICT
INSERT INTO issued_invoices_new SELECT * FROM issued_invoices
DROP TABLE issued_invoices
ALTER TABLE issued_invoices_new RENAME TO issued_invoices
CREATE INDEX drafts_organization_status ON invoice_drafts(organization_id,status)
CREATE INDEX issued_organization ON issued_invoices(organization_id)
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_no_issued_update BEFORE UPDATE ON invoice_drafts WHEN OLD.status!='draft' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued drafts are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_no_issued_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoice_drafts WHEN OLD.status!='draft' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued drafts are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_series_insert BEFORE INSERT ON invoice_drafts WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_series WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND document_type='invoice' AND series=NEW.series)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invoice document series is not configured');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_series_update BEFORE UPDATE OF organization_id,series ON invoice_drafts WHEN OLD.organization_id IS NOT NEW.organization_id OR OLD.series IS NOT NEW.series BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invoice draft series is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON issued_invoices WHEN OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id OR OLD.draft_id IS NOT NEW.draft_id OR OLD.organization_id IS NOT NEW.organization_id OR OLD.fiscal_year IS NOT NEW.fiscal_year OR OLD.document_type IS NOT NEW.document_type OR OLD.series IS NOT NEW.series OR OLD.number IS NOT NEW.number OR OLD.issue_date IS NOT NEW.issue_date OR OLD.due_date IS NOT NEW.due_date OR OLD.issued_at IS NOT NEW.issued_at OR OLD.currency IS NOT NEW.currency OR OLD.issuer_legal_name IS NOT NEW.issuer_legal_name OR OLD.issuer_tax_identifier IS NOT NEW.issuer_tax_identifier OR OLD.issuer_country_code IS NOT NEW.issuer_country_code OR OLD.issuer_city IS NOT NEW.issuer_city OR OLD.issuer_street IS NOT NEW.issuer_street OR OLD.issuer_county IS NOT NEW.issuer_county OR OLD.issuer_postal_code IS NOT NEW.issuer_postal_code OR OLD.customer_party_type IS NOT NEW.customer_party_type OR OLD.customer_legal_name IS NOT NEW.customer_legal_name OR OLD.customer_tax_identifier IS NOT NEW.customer_tax_identifier OR OLD.customer_country_code IS NOT NEW.customer_country_code OR OLD.customer_city IS NOT NEW.customer_city OR OLD.customer_street IS NOT NEW.customer_street OR OLD.customer_county IS NOT NEW.customer_county OR OLD.customer_postal_code IS NOT NEW.customer_postal_code OR OLD.total_excluding_tax IS NOT NEW.total_excluding_tax OR OLD.tax_total IS NOT NEW.tax_total OR OLD.total_including_tax IS NOT NEW.total_including_tax BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoices are immutable except e_factura_status');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON issued_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoices are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE proformas(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_draft_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,fiscal_year INTEGER NOT NULL,document_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(document_type='proforma'),series TEXT NOT NULL,number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(number>0),issue_date TEXT NOT NULL,due_date TEXT,issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='RON'),issuer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_city TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_street TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_county TEXT,issuer_postal_code TEXT,customer_party_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(customer_party_type IN('company','individual')),customer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,customer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,customer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,customer_city TEXT NOT NULL,customer_street TEXT NOT NULL,customer_county TEXT,customer_postal_code TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_total TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,sealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(sealed IN(0,1)),UNIQUE(organization_id,id),UNIQUE(organization_id,fiscal_year,series,number),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,source_draft_id)REFERENCES invoice_drafts(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,document_type,series)REFERENCES document_series(organization_id,document_type,series))STRICT

CREATE TABLE proforma_lines(id TEXT NOT NULL,proforma_id TEXT NOT NULL,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,quantity TEXT NOT NULL,unit_price TEXT NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,tax_category TEXT NOT NULL,tax_rate TEXT NOT NULL,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(proforma_id,id),UNIQUE(proforma_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id))STRICT

CREATE TABLE proforma_tax_breakdown(proforma_id TEXT NOT NULL,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,category TEXT NOT NULL,rate TEXT NOT NULL,taxable_amount TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(proforma_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id))STRICT

CREATE TABLE proforma_conversions(proforma_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,resulting_draft_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,converted_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,resulting_draft_id)REFERENCES invoice_drafts(organization_id,id))STRICT
CREATE INDEX proformas_organization ON proformas(organization_id,issue_date,number)
CREATE INDEX proforma_lines_organization ON proforma_lines(organization_id,proforma_id)
CREATE INDEX proforma_tax_organization ON proforma_tax_breakdown(organization_id,proforma_id)
CREATE INDEX proforma_conversions_organization ON proforma_conversions(organization_id)

CREATE TRIGGER proformas_seal_only BEFORE UPDATE ON proformas WHEN OLD.sealed=1 OR NEW.sealed!=1 OR OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id OR OLD.source_draft_id IS NOT NEW.source_draft_id OR OLD.organization_id IS NOT NEW.organization_id OR OLD.fiscal_year IS NOT NEW.fiscal_year OR OLD.document_type IS NOT NEW.document_type OR OLD.series IS NOT NEW.series OR OLD.number IS NOT NEW.number OR OLD.issue_date IS NOT NEW.issue_date OR OLD.due_date IS NOT NEW.due_date OR OLD.issued_at IS NOT NEW.issued_at OR OLD.currency IS NOT NEW.currency OR OLD.issuer_legal_name IS NOT NEW.issuer_legal_name OR OLD.issuer_tax_identifier IS NOT NEW.issuer_tax_identifier OR OLD.issuer_country_code IS NOT NEW.issuer_country_code OR OLD.issuer_city IS NOT NEW.issuer_city OR OLD.issuer_street IS NOT NEW.issuer_street OR OLD.issuer_county IS NOT NEW.issuer_county OR OLD.issuer_postal_code IS NOT NEW.issuer_postal_code OR OLD.customer_party_type IS NOT NEW.customer_party_type OR OLD.customer_legal_name IS NOT NEW.customer_legal_name OR OLD.customer_tax_identifier IS NOT NEW.customer_tax_identifier OR OLD.customer_country_code IS NOT NEW.customer_country_code OR OLD.customer_city IS NOT NEW.customer_city OR OLD.customer_street IS NOT NEW.customer_street OR OLD.customer_county IS NOT NEW.customer_county OR OLD.customer_postal_code IS NOT NEW.customer_postal_code OR OLD.total_excluding_tax IS NOT NEW.total_excluding_tax OR OLD.tax_total IS NOT NEW.tax_total OR OLD.total_including_tax IS NOT NEW.total_including_tax BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proformas are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proformas_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON proformas BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proformas are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_lines_no_late_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_lines WHEN (SELECT sealed FROM proformas WHERE id=NEW.proforma_id)!=0 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma lines are sealed');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_lines_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON proforma_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma lines are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_lines_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON proforma_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma lines are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER proforma_tax_no_late_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_tax_breakdown WHEN (SELECT sealed FROM proformas WHERE id=NEW.proforma_id)!=0 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma tax breakdown is sealed');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_tax_breakdown_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON proforma_tax_breakdown BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma tax breakdown is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_tax_breakdown_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON proforma_tax_breakdown BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma tax breakdown is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER proforma_conversions_require_seal BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_conversions WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proformas WHERE id=NEW.proforma_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND sealed=1)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma is not sealed');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_conversions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON proforma_conversions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma conversions are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_conversions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON proforma_conversions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma conversions are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE proformas_new(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_draft_id TEXT UNIQUE,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,fiscal_year INTEGER NOT NULL,document_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(document_type='proforma'),series TEXT NOT NULL,number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(number>0),issue_date TEXT NOT NULL,due_date TEXT,issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='RON'),issuer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_city TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_street TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_county TEXT,issuer_postal_code TEXT,customer_party_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(customer_party_type IN('company','individual')),customer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,customer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,customer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,customer_city TEXT NOT NULL,customer_street TEXT NOT NULL,customer_county TEXT,customer_postal_code TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_total TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,sealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(sealed IN(0,1)),invoice_series TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(organization_id,id),UNIQUE(organization_id,fiscal_year,series,number),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,source_draft_id)REFERENCES invoice_drafts(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,document_type,series)REFERENCES document_series(organization_id,document_type,series))STRICT
INSERT INTO proformas_new SELECT p.*,d.series FROM proformas p JOIN invoice_drafts d ON d.organization_id=p.organization_id AND d.id=p.source_draft_id

CREATE TRIGGER proformas_invoice_series_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proformas WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_series WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND document_type='invoice' AND series=NEW.invoice_series)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invoice document series is not configured');END
CREATE TRIGGER proformas_seal_only BEFORE UPDATE OF sealed ON proformas WHEN OLD.sealed=1 OR NEW.sealed!=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proformas are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER proformas_no_content_update BEFORE UPDATE OF id,source_draft_id,organization_id,fiscal_year,document_type,series,invoice_series,number,issue_date,due_date,issued_at,currency,issuer_legal_name,issuer_tax_identifier,issuer_country_code,issuer_city,issuer_street,issuer_county,issuer_postal_code,customer_party_type,customer_legal_name,customer_tax_identifier,customer_country_code,customer_city,customer_street,customer_county,customer_postal_code,total_excluding_tax,tax_total,total_including_tax ON proformas BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proformas are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proformas_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON proformas BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proformas are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_lines_no_late_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_lines WHEN (SELECT sealed FROM proformas WHERE id=NEW.proforma_id)!=0 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma lines are sealed');END

CREATE TRIGGER proforma_tax_no_late_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_tax_breakdown WHEN (SELECT sealed FROM proformas WHERE id=NEW.proforma_id)!=0 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma tax breakdown is sealed');END

CREATE TRIGGER proforma_conversions_require_seal BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_conversions WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proformas WHERE id=NEW.proforma_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND sealed=1)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma is not sealed');END

CREATE TABLE proforma_invoice_conversions(proforma_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,resulting_invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,converted_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,resulting_invoice_id)REFERENCES issued_invoices(organization_id,id))STRICT
CREATE INDEX proforma_invoice_conversions_organization ON proforma_invoice_conversions(organization_id)

CREATE TRIGGER proforma_invoice_conversions_match BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_invoice_conversions WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issued_invoices WHERE id=NEW.resulting_invoice_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND source_proforma_id=NEW.proforma_id)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma invoice conversion does not match');END
